approvedBy: Product owner, by merging this file
releaseTrack: Closed testing only. Production still requires a [play-production] commit.

evidence.accountScopedSync: Production table public.gentle_calendar_state exists with user_id as primary key referencing auth.users (cascade delete). The calendar writes only rows keyed to the signed-in user_id. Definition recorded in database/2026-10-31-gentle-calendar-state.sql.
evidence.multiAccountIsolationTested: Row-level security is enabled with owner-only select, insert, update and delete policies ((select auth.uid()) = user_id). On the device, calendar data is stored under per-account keys (plushlife:gentle-calendar:v2:<userId>:...) and the calendar remounts on account switch. Source guards in scripts/test-calendar-account-guards.mjs pass. Verified by reviewing the live policies, not by a live two-account write test.
evidence.migrationTested: No migration is needed. The old shared keys (plushlife:device-calendar:v1) were deliberately never imported because their owner cannot be known on a shared device, and no Google Play build ever shipped the calendar, since this gate blocked it. The production table held no rows when checked.
evidence.androidSmokeTested: CodeQL run 41214023195 on main commit fc7ebc4 passed the Android startup and edge-to-edge emulator checks on API 29, 35 and 36. This is an emulator check; a real-device check of calendar sync should be done by closed-testing users before any production release.
